theme: A quiet day at sea, with Florida-trip bookings closing in.
greeting: You're mid-charter on the Adriatic and the girls are home in Florida with Jen, so today's real cargo is a handful of travel bookings that don't wait well. One evening Zoom with the NACD New England committee, and otherwise the water is yours.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb switch closes Sept 18
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 - Oct 5 booking ($2,331) charges Sept 18; if a better option is going to replace it, the swap has to happen before then. After that it's paid.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers for Sept 19 still open
needsAttention.detail: The hotel is booked, but the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, the early checkout Sunday, and the midday bag hold all still need arranging - and all are hard to do once you're offline on the boat.

needsAttention.title: Sept 20 - Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge - a full-size SUV out of TPA for the Sept 20 landing needs booking outright so you're not at a walk-up counter jet-lagged on a Sunday.

schedule.title: NACD New England Programming Committee
schedule.detail: Zoom - 7 PM your time in Croatia

flagged.title: Brunswick passed your resume along
flagged.detail: Lauren Nadig shared your CV with recruitment and with Courtney in New York, and says she'll follow up with names.

flagged.title: Sr. Director, US Public Affairs posted
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flags an EPM Scientific public-affairs role squarely in your wheelhouse.

flagged.title: Philip wants to reconnect before his cruise
flagged.detail: An old Maine friend writes that the summer got away from you both; he leaves Saturday for two weeks in the Med.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail sales, newsletters, and boating-app location pings from Mike.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first crisp apples, and a free-form galette lets them shine with minimal fuss.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas rental - full-size SUV, PWM
Confirm the Nautilus return transfer for Sept 19
Disney tickets for the Sept 26-27 Orlando weekend

acts.line: An unhurried Adriatic morning - nothing on the calendar and the girls with Jen back in Florida.
Open water and an open calendar; the only tether is a few travel bookings with windows starting to close.
The NACD New England programming committee meets at 1 PM ET, which lands at 7 in the evening where you are.
